title: Connecting marvin to a cassandra server in the same compose file fails
body:
I'm trying to get marvin, code as of 03.03.2025, running in a compose file.

The cassandra image starts up, I can exec into it to create the keyspace mentioned in the README.md , but whatever way I tried, the spring-boot application cannot connect to cassandra. I always get 

```
Connection refused: cassandra/172.25.0.2:9042
```

even when using the compose file in the github project itself. As per my understanding, the cassandra image should allow any connections from anywhere by default:

```
# AllowAllAuthenticator performs no checks - set it to disable authentication.
authenticator: AllowAllAuthenticator
# Out of the box, Cassandra provides org.apache.cassandra.auth.{AllowAllAuthorizer,
# AllowAllAuthorizer allows any action to any user - set it to disable authorization.
authorizer: AllowAllAuthorizer
# Out of the box, Cassandra provides org.apache.cassandra.auth.{AllowAllNetworkAuthorizer,
# AllowAllNetworkAuthorizer allows access to any DC to any user - set it to disable authorization.
network_authorizer: AllowAllNetworkAuthorizer
```

The property

```
VECTORDB_ADDRESS: cassandra:9042
```

is set, I tried with both the port number and without...

Any suggestions where I might dig further?
author: hakan42

comments.body: What fixed it was bumping spring boot version
Oh nice... Another thing to learn :)

title: Auto-creation of Cassandra database from scratch failing
body:
I have set up a marvin deployment with the current codebase (as of 19.12.2024, right after your "Refactored control access into domain" commit).

cassandra runs with a clean volume, initializing from zero.

In the first run, I got the error message "Invalid keyspace springframework", even with the key "CREATE_IF_NOT_EXISTS" set in application.yml

Next, I execed into the cassandra container, created the keyspace manually:

`CREATE  KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS springframework WITH replication = {'class':'SimpleStrategy', 'replication_factor' : 1};
`

Unfortunately, the next error is `IllegalStateException: table %s does not exist` 

Is there a guideline how to set up cassandra from scratch? Or, could you verify whether the initial setup works if you try with a clean, empty, data volume?
author: hakan42

comments.body: The teach profile had a config setting that disappeared when removing the profile. Check the deleted yml file.

spring:
  ai:
    vectorstore:
      cassandra:
        initialize-schema: true
